symbol.method: Built-in image generation followed by extraction of the symbol only; generated lettering was rejected.
symbol.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a polished, distinctive primary logo for "FlitzFS", a modern Windows compressed filesystem. This is a NEW logo, not an archive/ZIP product.
Brand-family reference, observed in the owner's current FlitzZip SVG: vivid red #ff303a, charcoal #15171c, bold clean sans-serif wordmark, and three outlined isometric diamond layers. Carry over the confident red/charcoal contrast and the idea of compact geometric layers, but invent a clearly DIFFERENT mark.
Design a memorable compact F monogram formed by tightly integrated storage planes / compressed data layers. Use deliberate negative space, balanced angular geometry and subtly forward-moving energy. It should feel like a coherent filesystem volume: ordered, fast, efficient and dependable. A restrained dimensional hint is welcome, but keep the mark flat/vector-friendly, crisp and legible at small sizes. Avoid simply repeating the three separate diamond outlines.
Composition: one horizontal brand lockup, distinctive red symbol on the left and the exact wordmark "FlitzFS" on the right in a strong custom-feeling charcoal sans-serif. Text spelling must be exactly F-l-i-t-z-F-S. Balanced spacing, excellent optical alignment, substantial clear space. No tagline.
Actual transparent background. No checkerboard baked in. No mockup, glossy 3D surface, drop shadow, generic GPU chip, padlock, hard-drive clipart, zipper, archive box, extra icons, labels, or watermark. Deliver one finished, elegant, professional logo.

wordmark.method: Native GraphicsPath.AddString glyph outlines, uniformly scaled and placed. No font binaries included.

limitations: Symbol is raster; SVG lettering is outlined actual font.
No inference of filesystem performance or readiness.
